pc.note: Measured issue225 teacher campaign plus a conservative 900-second implementation and preparation debit.

iteration.name: narrow_guard
iteration.changed_factor: Frozen action selection receives a conservative escape override; checkpoint bytes and all learned values remain fixed.
requires: unchanged field, visible coins, score, and opponent count
no bombs or explosions during the complete window
a visible coin or live opponent remains
the selected directional action returns to the recent position set
iteration.alternative: Highest-Q legal directional action that leaves the recent set, has a five-arrival safe continuation, and is outside every opponent's current or one-step-reachable tile.

selection: Pilot passes only if both registered blocks reduce eligible loop-window rate by at least 25%, at least 20 games are actually guarded in total, pooled score and kills do not decrease, and every registered safety, retention, action-correctness, and latency gate passes. Only then run the equally sized fresh confirmation. Never promote automatically.
fallback_if_failed: Retain every result, analyze the failure, and prospectively register at most one next anti-loop iteration under this same campaign budget and deadline.
